title: Higher National Diploma In Sports Management (Level 5)
description: This qualification develops the knowledge and practical skills required to manage, lead and deliver sports, coaching, fitness and community sports programmes effectively.
longDescription: This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of sports management, coaching and physical activity. It explores contemporary challenges, digital learning, personal development and innovation in the sports industry. Learners develop coaching, mentoring, fitness and well-being management skills. The programme examines community sports planning, professional sports environments and sports infrastructure operations. It prepares learners for management, leadership and operational roles across the sports and physical activity sector.
courseDetails: Evaluate contemporary challenges, digital developments and social influences affecting the sports industry. Apply coaching, advanced coaching and mentoring principles to support individual and team performance. Plan and manage fitness, physical activity and well-being programmes for diverse participants. Analyse sporting structures and develop effective strategies for community sports planning and delivery. Demonstrate leadership, creativity, personal branding and professional development skills for sustainable employment in sports. Evaluate the management, design, operation and delivery of professional sports environments and infrastructure. entry: For entry into Diploma Level 5 in Sports Management, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. This programme will be delivered by one of GSS’s partner institutions.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
